label: HOENN
arrive: The new warehouse smells like salt and rope. {brought} looks around, cracks their knuckles and grins.
"Just like old times, Boss. Except this time I know what I'm doing."
Out on the water, a red boat and a blue boat pass each other without slowing down.

owner.name: Professor Birch
owner.line: Always out in the field. The lab door sticks.

owner.name: The neighbours
owner.line: Every new family gets a cake. Every stranger gets a look.

owner.name: Trainers on the route
owner.line: Kids with their first partner.

owner.name: The Mart clerk
owner.line: Quiet town, quiet till.

owner.name: Bug maniacs
owner.line: Shroomish everywhere, and a man looking for them.

owner.name: Town families
owner.line: Comfortable houses with nice gardens.

owner.name: The night guard
owner.line: Devon parts are worth more than Devon guards.

owner.name: The schoolteacher
owner.line: Thirty pupils, one gate, no fence.

owner.name: Tunnel diggers
owner.line: Digging a tunnel by hand to Verdanturf.

owner.name: The stall holders
owner.line: Twenty stalls; every one sells something they shouldn't.

owner.name: Captain Stern
owner.line: Building a submarine. Talks about nothing else.

owner.name: The curator
owner.line: A red team and a blue team both want his parts.

owner.name: The store manager
owner.line: Half of Hoenn shops under this one roof.

owner.name: The floor boss
owner.line: The slots pay out on Sundays. Mostly.

owner.name: Officer Jenny
owner.line: Runs the city's only police post. Takes it seriously.

owner.name: The contest staff
owner.line: Ash falls on the stage; the crowd cheers anyway.

owner.name: The Draconid
owner.line: An old woman who knows every rock in the falls.

owner.name: Ash gatherers
owner.line: Glass flutes made from volcanic ash.

owner.name: The spring owners
owner.line: Everyone talks in the hot springs.

owner.name: The cable car crew
owner.line: One car up, one car down. Magma rides both.

owner.name: The herbalist
owner.line: Bitter medicine, honest prices.

owner.name: The decor seller
owner.line: Sells furniture for secret bases, no questions.

owner.name: The head scientist
owner.line: Both teams want his forecast. Neither asks nicely.

owner.name: Rain watchers
owner.line: It rains here every day of the year.

owner.name: The floor manager
owner.line: The biggest store in Hoenn, right on the cove.

owner.name: The cove fishermen
owner.line: They don't fish the cave mouth. They know why.

owner.name: The curator
owner.line: Paintings of Pokémon, and a very old safe.

owner.name: The keeper
owner.line: He says the cave is breathing.

owner.name: The townsfolk
owner.line: A town inside a volcano. Nobody leaves.

owner.name: Divers
owner.line: Seaweed and old wrecks under the surface.

business.name: Slateport Market
business.text: Cash stalls: ₽150 a week comes back clean.

business.name: Devon Corporation
business.text: Devon parts: an Ultra Ball a week, and a Scope if you ask.

business.name: Treehouse Market
business.text: Base gear: +5% on jobs in Fortree.

business.name: Lilycove Dept. Store
business.text: The biggest store in Hoenn pays ₽300 more a week.

business.name: Stern's Shipyard
business.text: The Hero's boat ride is slower.

writers.name: Devon clerk Mr. Stone's aide
writers.quote: {first} filed Devon's papers for a year. Never lost one, never read one.

writers.name: Mr. Briney's neighbour
writers.quote: {first} helped mend the nets. Good with knots and secrets.

writers.name: Wattson's shop hand
writers.quote: {first} rewired half of Mauville and never got a shock. Lucky, or careful.

writers.name: Hot-spring attendant Rina
writers.quote: {first} sold eggs boiled in the springs. Polite to everyone, even Magma.

writers.name: Gym trainee Wally's uncle
writers.quote: {first} helped Wally train. Kind. Don't let that fool you.

writers.name: Treehouse carpenter Vance
writers.quote: {first} built rope bridges with me for two summers. Never fell once.

writers.name: Space Center guard Hollis
writers.quote: {first} worked nights at the launch pad. Saw the Magma lot coming before I did.
